meta_description:
1,240 likes, 6 comments - nivedithg on September 9, 2026: "POV: you wanted a quick escape from city chaos and accidentally found your new favourite reset spot 👀🌴

InterContinental Chennai on ECR is giving:
✨ resort mode ON
🌊 beachside slow mornings
🏊 pool days with zero agenda
🍽️ long breakfasts + lazy dinners
🛏️ rooms you genuinely don’t want to leave
🌅 sunsets that make you forget your screen time exists

And the best part? You get the full getaway vibe without planning some massive holiday.

Perfect for:
Couple staycations 💛
Family weekends 👨‍👩‍👧
Birthday escapes 🎂
Quick Chennai getaways 🚗
Or those “I just need to disappear for 48 hours” weekends 😭

My 5 reasons to stay here:
1️⃣ ECR location + beach vibes
2️⃣ Huge, beautiful resort property
3️⃣ Spacious premium rooms
4️⃣ Plenty of food options
5️⃣ Pool + spa + beach + proper switch-off mode

Basically… come for the staycation, stay because leaving feels unnecessary. 😂

📍 InterContinental Chennai Mahabalipuram Resort, ECR

Save this for your next Chennai/ECR escape and send it to the person who owes you a weekend getaway. 👀".
